title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle + vendoring for rke2 (CentOS/RHEL) + installer fixes
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: customers running on-prem in regulated environments requested official support for RKE2 on CentOS/RHEL variants (RHEL8/9, Alma/Scientific/CentOS-stream) and a reproducible offline bundle that vendors the distro-specific artifacts. This PR adds an RKE2/CentOS offline bundle, updates the onprem installer to handle distro-specific init/systemd and SELinux requirements, vendors additional images and TUF metadata for the air-gapped bundle, and patches Helm chart hooks that failed under older rke2 versions.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds a new offline bundle generator entry for rke2-centos which produces a tarball including distro packages, container images, and TUF metadata.
- Vendors and pins container images required for the control-plane and system components (containerd, rke2, weave/cilium variants).
- Updates the private-installer bootstrap scripts to detect cgroup driver and set kubelet flags for CentOS kernels and systemd versions.
- Adds SELinux-aware systemd unit templates and one-shot relabel step when running in enforcing mode.
- Fixes Helm chart pre-install hooks that were failing due to older helm-rke2 cluster-scoped CRDs; changes the hooks to use a wait-and-retry with idempotency checks.
- Terraform module updates: adds a boolean var for `enable_centos_compat` and a docstring describing kernel/sysctl recommendations for CentOS.
- Adds docs and an operations playbook for preparing air-gapped installs on CentOS/RHEL, including firewall and iptables rules to allow overlay networking.

Checklist: 
- [x] Offline bundle generator updated and smoke-tested locally.
- [x] Image vendoring pipeline artifacts verified in an air-gapped test VM.
- [x] Installer script path detection and unit templates tested on CentOS Stream 9 and AlmaLinux 8.
- [x] Helm charts adjusted and e2e helm smoke passed.
- [x] Terraform module default unchanged unless explicitly opted-in.
- [x] Docs updated (onprem/airgap/centos.md) and internal runbook added.

Testing and verification: 
- Performed full air-gapped install in a QEMU VM: bundle tar loaded, images loaded into local registry, installer ran, control-plane came up and Redwood private control-plane reported healthy.
- Run the perf-canary minimal workload to ensure inference sidecars start under rke2 on CentOS kernel. Latency/throughput within expected tolerance.
- CI: existing onprem unit/integration suites run; a flaky kubelet cgroup test required a retry in CI, rerun passed.

Migration/upgrade notes: clients upgrading from earlier installer should re-generate their bundles if they rely on centos images. Installer is backward compatible when `enable_centos_compat` is false.

Security notes: all images are pinned by digest; TUF metadata included in the bundle. Customers using FIPS/CIS profiles should validate their own images; we document KMS/HSM steps in the runbook.

Release notes: "Add RKE2/CentOS offline bundle and installer fixes for CentOS/RHEL-like distros; vendored images and TUF metadata; docs and terraform opt-in for CentOS compatibility."

testing_notes: Air-gapped install performed in QEMU VM (CentOS Stream 9) with local registry; full control-plane up in ~9 minutes.
Verified Kubelet cgroup detection correctly sets --cgroup-driver=systemd on tested kernels.
Verified SELinux relabel step only runs when /usr/sbin/selinuxenabled exits 0.
Helm preinstall hook now waits up to 120s total with backoff for CRD availability to avoid race conditions on older rke2 clusters.
release_notes: Add RKE2/CentOS offline bundle and installer compatibility fixes; vendors images and TUF metadata; docs and terraform opt-in for CentOS compatibility.
notes_for_ops: Operators must regenerate their offline bundles for CentOS/RHEL environments and enable 'enable_centos_compat' in terraform when using distro-specific kernels. See docs/onprem/airgap/centos.md for checklist (kernel params, firewall, SELinux relabel).
